subsystems.name: Optical pulse sensor
subsystems.role: detects blood volume changes in the wrist artery with each heartbeat.

subsystems.name: Contact pressure sensor
subsystems.role: measures how firmly the device presses on the wrist, because contact force changes the optical signal.

subsystems.name: Motion sensors
subsystems.role: detect movement and arm position so those effects can be filtered out.

subsystems.name: Signal processing and algorithm unit
subsystems.role: turns raw pulse waveforms into a blood pressure estimate.

subsystems.name: Calibration and reference interface
subsystems.role: anchors the estimate to a trusted measurement from a standard cuff.

subsystems.name: Power and housing
subsystems.role: keeps the device running all day and in stable contact with the skin.

buildSteps.title: Design the sensor layout
buildSteps.detail: Position LEDs and photodiodes so they get a strong pulse signal from the radial artery at the wrist.

buildSteps.title: Build the analog front end
buildSteps.detail: Amplify and filter the tiny optical signal before it is digitised, keeping noise low.

buildSteps.title: Develop the algorithm
buildSteps.detail: Extract features such as pulse shape, timing and pulse wave velocity, then train a model on many paired cuff and sensor recordings.

buildSteps.title: Define the calibration method
buildSteps.detail: Decide how often the user must take a standard cuff reading to keep estimates accurate for their body.

buildSteps.title: Validate clinically
buildSteps.detail: Compare device readings against a standard cuff in diverse people, postures and conditions, following a recognised test protocol.

buildSteps.title: Obtain regulatory clearance
buildSteps.detail: Submit evidence to a medical device regulator for the intended use, such as monitoring trends rather than diagnosing.

buildSteps.title: Manufacture and test
buildSteps.detail: Assemble sensors, electronics and battery into a wrist-worn housing, then test each unit for signal quality and safety.

buildSteps.title: Deploy with software
buildSteps.detail: Provide an app that guides calibration, displays trends over time and flags readings that need medical attention.
